# bus users — every Core and Edge page that reaches shared/bus.js, from the templates and the
# static import graph: what it subscribes, and whether it opens a stream. The rule is
# bus.js's: a server topic opens the stream, the bus's own frames (connected, disconnected, heartbeat, stream-gap, build-changed) never do.
# A non-literal onSSE type is listed as it is written; the station's are its stationEvents keys.

core bins.html: opens a stream; topics bin-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed
core config.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core count-history.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed,connected
core cycle-time.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core dashboard-display.html: opens a stream; topics order-update; bus frames connected,disconnected
core dashboard-frame.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core dashboard-map.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,robot-update; bus frames connected,disconnected
core dashboard-node-report.html: opens a stream; topics bin-update,node-update; bus frames connected,disconnected
core dashboard.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed
core demand-episode.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core demand-episodes.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core diagnostics.html: opens a stream; topics cms-transaction,debug-log,fire-alarm,system-status; bus frames build-changed
core edges.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core heartbeat.html: opens a stream; topics cell-heartbeat; bus frames connected,disconnected
core inventory.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed,connected
core login.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core material-flags.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core mission-detail.html: opens a stream; topics mission-event,order-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed
core missions.html: opens a stream; topics cell-heartbeat,system-status; bus frames build-changed,connected
core nodes.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core orders.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed
core orphans.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core overview.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,robot-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed,connected
core payloads.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core rds_explorer.html: opens a stream; topics system-status; bus frames build-changed
core robots.html: opens a stream; topics robot-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed
core sourcing.html: opens a stream; topics bin-update,sourcing-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed,connected,disconnected
core test-orders.html: opens a stream; topics order-update,system-status; bus frames build-changed
edge changeover.html: opens a stream; topics changeover-update,order-failed,order-update; bus frames build-changed
edge config.html: no bus
edge containment.html: opens a stream; topics containment; bus frames build-changed
edge diagnostics.html: opens a stream; topics debug-log; bus frames build-changed
edge login.html: no bus
edge manual-message.html: no bus
edge manual-order.html: opens a stream; topics core-nodes; bus frames build-changed
edge operator-display.html: opens a stream; operator-station/operator.js: onSSE(type, …); bus frames connected,disconnected,heartbeat,stream-gap
edge orders.html: opens a stream; topics order-completed,order-failed,order-update; bus frames build-changed
edge processes.html: no bus
edge production.html: opens a stream; topics core-nodes,counter-update,order-failed,order-update; bus frames build-changed
edge replenishment.html: no bus
